concept.reason: True museum fossil skeleton plus original taxonomic paper sufficient; historical skin sculpture explicitly excluded.

scope: Complete animal with very large deep head, expanded lateral cheek flanges and comparatively narrow torso. Anchor CM1594 skeleton, not historical skin sculpture CM2503.

scientific_limits.en: CM1594 mounted fossil is the form anchor, not historical soft-tissue sculpture CM2503. Museum approximately six feet shoulder height is an estimate, not exact bone measurement. Lucas etal1998 CM1594 tooth lengths are directly reported; body dimensions selected below are modeling estimates. Cheek flanges are not the huge anterior chin tubercles of Archaeotherium: CM1594 has only a small chin tubercle. Lips, skin, ears, tail flesh, color inferred. No literal giant domestic pig, no certainty about all modern phylogenetic details.
scientific_limits.zh: 以CM1594真实展骨为形态锚，不用CM2503历史皮肤像。博物馆约六英尺肩高是估值非精确骨测；1998论文CM1594牙尺寸为报告值，全体参数另为美术估计。宽颊突不等于Archaeotherium巨大前下颏瘤，CM1594仅小下颏结节；唇皮耳尾色推定，不造巨型家猪。

classification: Mammalia, Artiodactyla, Entelodontidae; Dinohyus hollandi historical synonym, not modern Suidae.

scale.status: Tooth measurements directly reported Table2 p431; museumheight approximate; all other dimensions artistic estimates, not newly measured skeleton or species mean.

diagnostic_targets: Huge elongated deep skull with strongly expanded paired lateral cheek arches/flanges.
Small chin tubercle only, no Archaeotherium-like huge anterior chin bosses.
Comparatively narrow deep torso supported by four relatively long legs and paired central hooves.
High shoulder support and substantial neck for heavy head, avoid giant round domestic pig torso.
Modest mouth opening reveals conical teeth/canines without exaggerated warthog curling tusks.
Complete body and narrow shortish tail, restrained inferred skin/ears/color.
acceptance: Huge deep head, broad paired cheek flanges, narrow torso all evident as original combination.
Top/front show symmetrical cheek expansion distinct from chin; side preserves small chin tubercle and long deep muzzle.
Four tall weightbearing limbs, paired central hooves, shoulder support and full tail retained.
Approximate wholebody scale not conflated with reported CM1594 cheektooth measurements.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds and independent review.
